notes.title: Bullet Noir 1.0 is Finally Here – Revenge Has Never Been Darker
notes.notes:
[p]Developed as part of our Indie Initiative, which nurtures in-house grassroots game projects into full releases, we are proud to launch [i]Bullet Noir[/i] after an Early Access phase filled with updates and improvements!
[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="oKEfGO02uMQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Step Into a Neo-Noir World Filled with Revenge[/b][/h3][p][b]
[/b][i]Bullet Noir[/i] is a gritty, fast-paced shooter that invites players to uncover the backstories of four uniquely driven protagonists, each consumed by a personal vendetta. As the plot unfolds, you will navigate each character’s personal story, intertwined with the larger narrative. [/p][p align="justify"]The game’s one-hit-one-kill mechanic offers intense showdowns around every corner, whether you’re charging in guns blazing or opting for a stealthier approach. Navigate through a rain-slicked metropolis of alleys, hovels, and high-rises, and carve your own path through each protagonist’s overlapping quest for vengeance.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Meets Style
[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]“What excites us the most about [i]Bullet Noir[/i] is how style and gameplay seamlessly fuse together,” said Tavi Petre, Game Director of [i]Bullet Noir[/i]. “It’s not just about shooting - it’s about stepping into a noir world. The mood, the atmosphere, and the tension are just as important as the bullets.”[/p][p align="justify"]“For all of us at Wolcen Studio, launching [i]Bullet Noir[/i] means so much to us,” said Bodgan Oprescu, President of Wolcen Studio. “It’s about the embodiment of our philosophy: to take risks, embrace style, and give creators in our studio the freedom to experiment. This is the first game of our Indie Initiative - which we created for games just like this!”[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s New In 1.0
[/b][/h3][p]During Early Access, [i]Bullet Noir [/i]featured a story mode made up of four chapters, with 24 levels in total. With each chapter, you would step into the shoes of one of our four protagonists, experiencing the story through their eyes. While these chapters told unique, character-focused stories, they also revealed the motivations and backstories of our four protagonists.[/p][p]
[/p][p]With 1.0, we’re taking the business of revenge one step further with; [/p][list][*][p][b]A brand new chapter[/b], taking it to 35 levels, uncovering the rest of the story, featuring new cinematics[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Speedrun & Arcade modes[/b], playable with all four characters[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full controller support and polished UI[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]35 Steam achievements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Global leaderboards[/b] across all three game modes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization[/b] in English, French, Spanish, Italian, and German 

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]A Message To Our Community[/b][/h3][p]As we proudly release the full version of [i]Bullet Noir[/i], we want to thank every single player who supported us during Early Access. Your feedback and passion carried us through, and we can’t wait to hear what you think of the journey ahead.[/p][p][i]Bullet Noir[/i] is available now for $11.99 / £9.99 / €11.79, with a 20% launch discount during the first week post-launch.[/p][p][i][b]If you played during Early Access, please note that all leaderboards have been reset. For the best and most seamless experience, we recommend starting a fresh save rather than continuing an old one.[/b][/i][/p][p]The city awaits. Grab your guns and start your hunt.[/p][p]Check out our website: [/p][p][url="https://www.bulletnoir.com/"]https://www.bulletnoir.com/[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Get Bullet Noir on Steam:[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/bulletnoirgame.bsky.social" style="button"]Follow us on Bluesky[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/BulletNoir_game" style="button"]Follow us on X [/url][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/bulletnoirgame/" style="button"]Follow us on Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/GcWB2gn6" style="button"]Join our Discord community[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.wolcen-studio.com/" style="button"]Visit the Wolcen Studio website[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2: Choose Your Challenge: Standard vs. Hardcore Mode
notes.notes:
Our second devlog dives into the two difficulty options available in Bullet Noir.

Standard Mode is for those who enjoy a challenge without the intensity turned up to 11. It’s tough, but with a bit of grit and determination, most players will be able to make it through.

Hardcore Mode, on the other hand, is for those seeking a brutal, unforgiving experience. Enemies hit harder, timing is tighter, and mistakes are deadly. Perfect for players who live for high-stakes action.

notes.title: A few words about the game
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome! 
Today, we’d like to share more details about our game,[b] Bullet Noir.[/b] As the name suggests, it’s a[b] twin-stick shooter[/b], where every shot carries the potential for death. The game’s visual style is heavily inspired by the classic [b]noir genre[/b], with a dominant black-and-white color scheme designed to enhance the dark, gritty atmosphere of a world filled with gangsters and intense combat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/3f83f838c0e4fa443cf7a893ec6428bd05725ac9.gif[/img]

Our core [b]mechanical inspiration[/b] comes from the cult classic Hotline Miami, but we’ve added our own [b]unique twists[/b], such as a time-slowing mechanic reminiscent of The Matrix. This allows players to [b]slow down time[/b] in critical moments, adding an extra layer of strategy to each encounter. The game also features [b]tactical elements[/b], like the ability to take cover behind obstacles and approach missions in different ways. Whether you prefer to go in [b]guns blazing[/b] or take a [b]stealthy approach[/b], the [b]choice is yours[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/4887732f0ab82a73d1b75953a0c8bc227e44c06c.gif[/img]

[b]Enemies[/b] in Bullet Noir are designed to be reactive and dynamic. If they hear gunshots or notice suspicious activity, they’ll investigate the surroundings, creating opportunities for ambushes or forced confrontations. The [b]enemy variety[/b] is also worth mentioning — from basic guards to more advanced and challenging foes, the game continuously tests your reflexes and adaptability. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/e4bb1894922950da865340ba15cc93b2680e3271.gif[/img]

One key feature is the [b]isometric camera[/b] view, which gives you a [b]tactical advantage[/b] by allowing you to see around corners and plan your moves more effectively. This perspective adds depth to the gameplay, enabling you to make better strategic decisions and engage in more dynamic shootouts. 

We hope you’re as excited as we are about the game! [b]Stay tuned for more updates[/b].
